concerns.text: User Story 2 specifies sensitivity analysis offsets as '[deferred], [deferred], [deferred]' in the Independent Test section, but FR-005 explicitly defines the sweep range as '{10%, 20%, 30%}'. The spec should resolve this ambiguity in the User Story text to match the requirement, rather than leaving placeholders that contradict the defined requirement.

The Independent Test for User Story 2 lists specific values (0.1 ns, 0.5 ns, 1.0 ns) which are not present in the Functional Requirements (FR-005) or the User Story description itself. While these values are consistent with the 10% rule for a 10ns run, the spec should either explicitly link these values to the 10/20/30% rule in FR-005 or remove the specific numbers from the test to avoid confusion about whether the requirement is fixed percentages or fixed times.
